Export STABL Stability Scores to CSV

Source: R/exports.R
export_stabl_to_csv.Rd

Writes the full stability-score matrix, the per-feature maximum stability scores, and (when artificial features were used) the corresponding artificial-feature scores to CSV files in the directory specified by path.

Usage

export_stabl_to_csv(object, path)

Arguments

object

A fitted "stabl_fit" object from stabl_fit().

path

Character string; path to an existing (or to-be-created) directory.

Value

Invisibly returns path (as a normalized string).

Details

Files written:

  • STABL scores.csv — full p x L stability score matrix.

  • Max STABL scores.csv — per-feature maximum stability score, sorted descending.

  • STABL artificial scores.csv — artificial feature scores (only when artificial-feature scores are present, i.e. object$stabl_scores_artificial_ is not NULL).

  • Max STABL artificial scores.csv — artificial max scores, sorted descending (only when artificial features were used).

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1L)
x <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 6), 40, 6,
             dimnames = list(paste0("s", 1:40), paste0("f", 1:6)))
y <- setNames(rnorm(40), rownames(x))
fit <- stabl_fit(x, y,
                 lambda_grid  = data.frame(lambda = c(0.3, 0.1, 0.05)),
                 n_bootstraps = 6L, hard_threshold = 0.3, random_state = 1L)
out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "stabl_csv_export")
export_stabl_to_csv(fit, out_dir)
list.files(out_dir)
#> [1] "Max STABL artificial scores.csv" "Max STABL scores.csv"           
#> [3] "STABL artificial scores.csv"     "STABL scores.csv"               
# }
